entries.3346d67d999d87b8: A reportable segment whose main focus areas are electronics, mobility, and medical & healthcare, handling vehicle interior materials, leather, film, urethane, industrial materials, shock-absorbing materials, and others. From the fiscal year ended March 2026, the three previous categories of "Shoes Business," "Plastics Business," and "Industrial Materials Business" were replaced as reportable segments by three categories: "First Business Division," "Second Business Division," and "Shoes BU (Business Unit)." Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥49,910 million (up 7.8% from the previous fiscal year), and segment profit was ¥3,287 million (up 228.0% from the previous fiscal year). In addition to an increase in gross profit due to higher sales of film for the highly profitable medical field and of industrial materials, the cost of sales ratio improved through cost reductions such as consolidated production at manufacturing sites.

entries.5dcaae80bd747f6b: A category handling disaster prevention products. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, disaster prevention products such as tents and mats in Japan, boat products in the United States, and coated base fabric in China performed well, and sales exceeded the previous year's level.
entries.736d3e76cfa74691: A category handling insulation materials. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, board products remained firm in the non-residential field, including sheet waterproofing applications, and an increase in construction projects for system products and revisions to selling prices also contributed, so sales exceeded the previous year's level.
entries.7e5ed0d31cd59073: A category handling urethane products. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales for sundries were firm and sales for vehicles were on a recovery trend, but sales for bedding were weak, so sales fell below the previous year's level.
entries.7f85a44ed638d4ec: A reportable segment responsible for the shoe business. It releases new products that respond to health-conscious trends and changes in lifestyle under brands such as the comfort shoes "Achilles Sorbo," the running shoes "BROOKS," and "Shunsoku." Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥8,928 million (down 11.7% from the previous year). They fell below the previous year due to continued weak consumer spending, against a background of a declining birthrate and sluggish department stores, and the effect of price revisions. The segment loss was ¥321 million, an improvement from the loss of ¥972 million in the previous fiscal year, owing to price revisions, a review of procurement costs, and cost reductions.
entries.8f84b772afd8917a: A reportable segment whose main focus areas are construction & infrastructure and safety & activity, handling insulation materials, building interior materials, disaster prevention products, and others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥22,964 million (up 1.2% from the previous fiscal year), and segment profit was ¥2,390 million (up 26.9% from the previous fiscal year). Gross profit increased due to higher sales of insulation materials and building interior materials. Meanwhile, fixed assets related to the disaster prevention business were subject to an impairment loss recorded as an extraordinary loss, on the grounds that achieving the revenue assumed in the original business plan has been delayed; the impairment loss of the Second Business Division printed in the segment information is ¥905 million.

entries.d9089da8a97cc6d9: A category handling building interior materials. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, even amid a continued slump in the housing market, sales exceeded the previous year's level owing to revisions to selling prices and other factors.
